subject: CI: fix clang-tidy crashing on every file in the thread-safety check (#1733)
reason: The change is a CI fix (clang-tidy thread-safety check in the workflow and refresh_comp_db.sh) plus compile-time-only thread-safety annotations (ABSL_NO_THREAD_SAFETY_ANALYSIS / ABSL_SHARED_LOCKS_REQUIRED) and no-op refactors in src/ that read the same member through the existing GetIndexKeyInfo() accessor under the same locks; the remaining edits are to unit tests. None of it changes runtime behavior, commands, replies, locking, or persistence, so no fuzzer scenario can distinguish the two builds.
